source: Structural observation of user-supplied field form photographs; NO company records, signatures, logos, photos, or values embedded

general_report.review_notes: Checkboxes, notes and numerical counts are separate observations; missing means unknown, not zero.

concrete_strength.display_name: Compressive Strength of Concrete / Cylinder Field & Lab Sheet
concrete_strength.review_notes: Cast or picked-up cylinder counts must not be equated with strength results. Lab columns may be blank at field stage.

density_sheet.display_name: Tests for In-Place Density of Compacted Soils (multiple pages)
density_sheet.review_notes: Merge by authorized series/document ID and explicit page number. Do not assume same station means duplicate test. Pass/fail are recorded observations, not recalculated acceptance.

rebar_observation.review_notes: Qualitative comments require human interpretation; do not assert structural compliance.

cross_document_checks: recorded dry density versus wet density & moisture
recorded compaction versus measured dry and reference max dry
human_review_policy: Never auto-approve material or auto-send to ElmTree. Uncertain handwriting requires human verification and source page reference.
